description_en: Sends a message to the client
kebab_example: aliyun ice send-message-chat-text --session-id f27f9b9be28642a88e180000 --ai-agent-id 39f8e0bc005e4f309379701645f40000 --receiver-id 60000042053 --type announcement --text Hello. --biz-mode online --need-archiving true --region cn-hangzhou
name: SendMessageChatText

parameters.description_en: The ID of the AI agent.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the AI agent
parameters.name: ai_agent_id

parameters.description_en: The ID of the user who receives the message. The ID can be up to 64 bytes in length and can contain letters and digits.
parameters.description_zh: 接收消息的用户ID，由大小写字母、数字组成，长度不超过64字节。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the user who receives the message. The ID can be up to 64 bytes in length and can contain letters and digits
